subject: Linguistics
title: The Future of Language
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Future of Language.

hook.text: In 1900 nobody texted 'lol' or said 'OK.' Language constantly reinvents itself.

buildup.text: Technology drives change—emojis, voice assistants, and machine translation reshape how we communicate.

discovery.text: Some predict a single global language; others see the internet preserving minority languages.

twist.text: Creoles and pidgins keep emerging wherever communities with different languages meet.

climax.text: Language has survived ice ages, empires, and printing. It will survive the internet too.

punchline.text: Language changes — but it never stops.

quiz.question: What keeps new languages from forming?
